messages:
maria-support: FYI escalation from Beacon — their EU dedicated pool (eu-west-1, pool-id: ded-eu-07) started returning intermittent 429s and p95 token latency spiked ~3x since ~09:12 UTC. They say it correlates with other tenants being active on the same host.

beacon-prod-contact: saw it during a QA sweep — requests get a 429 for a few seconds, then clear. Attachments show throughput ~steady but tail latency jumps. Not seeing auth or billing errors.

omar-sre: Can you share a sample request id and the node id? Also which MIG partition size?

maria-support: sample req id: req_2026_03_17_091245_az. Node: host-az1-gpu-19. MIG layout reported as 3x1g.5gb + 1x2g.10gb (from inventory).

jess-eng: Thx — sounds like noisy neighbor + scheduling pressure. Did autoscale try to add more slices? Any failed scale events?

liam-platform: autoscale-bot posted a scale attempt at 09:13 but it failed with capacity constraint: "no compatible free slot in pool ded-eu-07". Policy was "min_slices=8, burst=2, max_slices=12".

autoscale-bot: [event] scale_attempt slice_add requested=1 pool=ded-eu-07 result=failed reason="no_free_slot_compatible_with_mig_profile"

omar-sre: Can we get DCGM and MIG metrics for host-az1-gpu-19 around the spike? I want SM utilization, memory BW, and L3 util if available. Also nvlink activity.

maria-support: pulled a short dump from the host: 
```
DCGM: SM util avg: 92% during spike window
Memory BW util: 78%
L3/cache evictions: elevated
MIG slices active: [1g.5gb x3 (tid: a,b,c), 2g.10gb x1 (tid: d)]
Processes: tenant-A (high batch jobs) on the 2g slice, tenant-Beacon on 1g slices.
```

kevin-research: These numbers suggest cross-slice interference — L3 thrash / memory BW saturation can propagate even between MIG slices on Ampere/next-gen. If tenant-A pushed large matrix workloads, it can cause transient stalls on other MIGs.

jess-eng: Confirmed similar in past incidents. Quick repro: run a sustained large matrix multiply on 2g slice while Beacon does low-latency token-by-token generation on 1g slices — observe p95 jump and 429s under our request queueing logic.

beacon-prod-contact: What's the short-term mitigation? They need production stability today.

liam-platform: Options: (1) bump Beacon to dedicated host (isolation) — takes ~30m to reprovision; (2) temporarily adjust scheduling to avoid packing heavy batch tenants on same host as low-latency tenants — quick policy change; (3) tune autoscale to prefer hosts with matching MIG profiles / reserve free compatible slot.

omar-sre: Also we can push a conservative throttle on tenant-A for the next hour (rate-limit large batch jobs) while we migrate Beacon off the host. Need agreement from support/SE.

maria-support: Beacon prefers migration over throttling. Can we prioritize a migration?

liam-platform: Opening migration job with tag high-priority now. Will try to allocate a new host with same model and MIG profile. If no perfect match, we can spin a fallback model variant (quantized) with routing fallback.

autoscale-bot: [migration] migrate_tenant tenant=Beacon from host=host-az1-gpu-19 status=queued priority=high

jess-eng: Post-mortem action items we should capture: add a scoring function to placement that penalizes co-locating heavy sustained-memory-bandwidth workloads with low-latency tenants; improve metrics to detect L3 evictions across slices; add an automatic short-lived guardrail to move low-latency traffic when co-residency noise detected.

kevin-research: For reproduction notes: small script to saturate memory BW on a 2g slice: 
```bash
# run on target MIG slice as tenant-A
python -c "import numpy as np; a=np.random.randn(12000,12000); b=a.dot(a); print(b[0,0])"
```
Run Beacon workload generator (token stepper) concurrently and measure p95.

maria-support: Migration started at 09:21 UTC. Beacon reports p95 normalizing by 09:28. No further 429s in the last 10m.

beacon-prod-contact: Confirmed — latency back to baseline. Thanks for the fast assist. :heart:

liam-platform: We'll follow up with a config change: temporarily reduce aggressive packing for ded-eu-07 and add a placement test to ensure at least 1 free compatible slot for low-latency tenants.

jess-eng: Filing an infra ticket for a placement policy update + automated detection rule.

omar-sre: Assigning post-incident owners: kevin (research) to validate cross-slice interference thresholds, jess (eng) to add placement rule, liam (platform) to adjust autoscale policy.

maria-support: Closing the customer escalation — Beacon notified. Will keep ticket open until placement rule is in prod.

kevin-research: Addendum: monitor L3 eviction counts as an early warning — when evictions per-second > X for > 15s, signal "co-residency-noise" and consider migration.

maria-support: Noted. I'll include that in the customer post-incident summary.
